subject.title: [Bug]: /hooks/agent silently drops accountId — hook dispatch bypasses cron normalization pipeline

question: Should maintainers continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43951 or replace it with a credited current-main fix for the hook `accountId` bug?
rationale: The issue is valid and source-reproducible, but the existing closing PR is open, conflicting, and missing real behavior proof, so automation should not queue a second fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep the linked PR as the landing path and wait for the author to rebase, resolve review findings, and add redacted real behavior proof.

options.title: Close stale PR, keep issue open
options.body: Close the unmergeable branch if maintainers do not want to wait, while keeping this issue as the canonical bug report.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway hook and SourceDeliveryPlan-adjacent history places this owner closest to the current-main refresh decision.
